run_print_config: run the script to print the whole config from a given config file path
run_print_config_with_save: run the script to print and save the config to a .py .json or .yml file
run_print_config_with_options: run the script to print the config with overridden key-value cfg options merged in
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that defines the config file path save path and cfg options arguments
review_main: review the main function that loads resolves and optionally dumps an mmengine Config object
